description.en: Clear editorial information graphics made of flat color fields and geometric shapes.
description.tr: Düz renk alanları ve geometrik şekillerle net, editoryal bilgi grafikleri.

colorRules.accent: one highlight per scene: the key bar, the active step, the moving signal

numerals.use: big data numbers, can bleed off the frame

shape.overlapRule: text crossing a shape switches color inside the shape (clip-path knockout), e.g. charcoal on sand becomes sand on teal

enter.from: scale 0 from the shape's own base or center

grow.use: bars, arrows, lines grow from their origin

motion.transition: a primary-colored shape scales up to fill the frame and becomes the next background
